sources: docs/proposals/vrm-author-cli/commands.md (`object set` is typed field access, not an arbitrary JSON patch bypass)

parameterRanges.values: non-empty map of RFC 6901 pointers to typed values; pointers must be writable

invariants: a writable-pointer edit is atomic: revision bumps once, the plan records before/after, invalidations are reported and the recipe stays in sync

ids, revision, provenance, presets, writable-pointer lists, rights, style hash, template, spring joint nodes, array appends and types are never editable; the project revision stays 0 after every refusal
the whole object is validated through its model type: range violations, unknown fields, wrong-arity rgba, dangling references, negative radii and mutually exclusive shapes are rejected
an empty values map, a non-pointer key, an unknown object, a missing values field and an extra field in the edit are rejected
a no-op edit succeeds with empty invalidations and still records a revision
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
scope.units: revisions are nonnegative integers; timeoutSeconds seconds; maxMemoryMb megabytes; control values in their descriptor units (metres, degrees, normalized)
excluded: editing derived geometry, history or credentials

mutants.description: testSetCannotTouchIdsHistoryCredentialsOrDerivedFields: each of the 11 forbidden pointers must be an invalid request with the project revision unchanged.
testSetValidatesWholeObjectThroughItsModelType: 13 model-invalid edits must be rejected before any of the 7 valid ones apply.
testSetRequiresNonEmptyValuesAndValidPointers: empty values, a key without a leading slash, an unknown object, a missing values field and an unknown edit field must be rejected.
ProjectPackTests.testAtomicRollbackOnFailedValidationMidEdit: a multi-value object set with one invalid value must apply nothing and write no receipt.
ProjectStoreTests.testWritablePointersAreEnforced: the store must refuse non-writable pointers independently of the handler.

visual.applicabilityRecord: object set is a typed-field revision transaction and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.
